reason: The hypothesis combines the specific carbon-induced carbide formation observed in a different RHEA under high pressure (P17) with the precipitation-strengthening strategy from light-weight RHEAs (P12) and applies it to the well-characterized irradiation-resistant W-Ta-Cr-V-Hf system (P1, P3, P6). This integration of carbide precipitation for simultaneous mechanical enhancement and maintained irradiation stability in a nanocrystalline RHEA is not proposed in any single passage, representing a synthesis of distinct findings.
